purpose: Hermes upgrade evidence. Records the upgrade CONTRACT (consumed from M014-S05-hermes-upgrade-contract.json) and the live execution POSTURE. In the auto-mode execution lane, T02 CANNOT open an authenticated SSH session to the live VPS (S02 verdict is H-INCONCLUSIVE; LFP-LF-02 forbids unattended live mutation). Therefore this artifact records an HONEST PLAN_READY + LIVE_EXECUTION_DEFERRED verdict with explicit per-step live_execution_status markers and live_execution_blockers, mirroring the S04-T04 fail-closed BLOCKED pattern.
phase_verdict_rationale: T02 in the auto-mode execution lane can produce the upgrade CONTRACT (plan, pin selection, compatibility review, rollback strategy, patch reconciliation plan) but cannot OPEN AN AUTHENTICATED SSH SESSION TO THE LIVE VPS to actually run pip install --upgrade hermes-agent==0.18.2. Producing a fake 'UPGRADE_VERIFIED' verdict here would constitute evidence laundering — instead, T02 records PLAN_READY + LIVE_EXECUTION_DEFERRED so T03/T04 can later promote the verdict once an operator-confirmed live execution happens.

The S02 forensics verdict (M014-S02-vps-forensics-verdict.json, H-INCONCLUSIVE) blocks all VPS mutation paths. The pre-flight checks (PFC-01..06) are documented in the contract but cannot be executed by T02; the live executor (operator-confirmed) must run them and append the results to this artifact's pre_flight_checks_results[].
